verdict.rationale: Omarchy is built on Arch's rolling-release package mirrors and AUR (including chaotic-aur), giving access to up-to-date apps and toolchains, and users report installing software as 'easy and lightning-fast.' However, evidence also shows it bundles a large fixed set of proprietary apps in a 7GB ISO and relies on community-maintained AUR packages, which introduces supply-chain risk rather than guaranteed 'latest and vetted' releases.
